The Dispatch - News Application¶

A publishing workspace built with Django. Editors manage companies and review stories, journalists write reporting, and readers follow approved content. Normal use does not require Django Admin or a superuser.

Start with Installation, then follow User walkthrough to publish your first article. Developers can inspect the actual Python docstrings in Python and HTTP reference.
